verified_checks: Source-audit hashes match every listed raw JSON, bar parquet, derived feature/normalized/price panel, calendar, and code file
All three derived panels contain exactly one row per original identity and shared session, with no duplicate date/identity keys
All excluded identities retain missing prices and correct exclusion reasons; APC and EMC reused tickers cannot enter features
Every normalized feature rank matches an independent same-day percentile-rank recomputation; sigma_daily exactly retains unranked volatility_20/sqrt(252)
For all 101 identities and four horizons, returns and label dates match independent shared-calendar endpoint recomputation
For all 101 identities, 20-session momentum and historical log-return volatility match independent price-based recomputation
All four candidate training/calibration splits exclude warm-up dates, purge horizon boundaries, and contain only accepted identities
US candidate comparison now uses common rows and common dates, with explicit zero skill for constant predictions
Production bootstrap refuses confidence intervals with fewer than 60 calendar slots or 60 finite observations

resolved_findings: Warm-up observations cannot enter fitting or tree feature-availability selection
Constant-score dates no longer receive candidate-specific IC exclusion
APC is ARKO Petroleum rather than original Anadarko; EMC is an ETF rather than original EMC Corp.; both are explicitly quarantined

method_limits: Current-vintage public vendor history, not point-in-time vendor snapshots
Fixed 2015 cohort with 12/101 unavailable or unresolved identities; excluded names represent 6.935474964416771% of the original 2015 equity holding value, not current exposure
Conditional observable-subset research; neither survivorship-free full-cohort inference nor broad-US inference
Provider identity-name/history review is not a complete permanent-identifier or corporate-action entitlement audit
Adjusted research units and source dollar-volume proxies are not verified exchange-share accounting or implementable close-price execution
Confirmation performance, fitted model hashes, final task coverage, replay output, and latest-refit separation require post-fit verification
